greeting.text: Welcome, child. The chapel is open to all who seek solace. How may I help you?

responses.text: Can you teach me about prayer?
Tell me about yourself, Brother Aldwin.

healing.text: Of course. Sit, rest. The Light mends all wounds in time. Let me see what ails you.

healed.text: There. The Light flows through you now. Rest a moment before you head back into danger, won't you?

healing_cost.text: The Light is freely given. I ask only a small offering for the chapel's upkeep. Whatever you can spare.

healed_free.text: Do not worry. The Light does not measure coin. Be well, and perhaps pay it forward to another in need.

healing_supplies.text: I keep blessed bandages and restorative draughts. Not as fancy as Elara's brews, but they'll keep you standing.

responses.text: Heal me first, then I'll browse.

post_heal_chat.text: You carry heavy burdens. I can see it. The Light asks only that you carry them with purpose, not alone.

responses.text: Tell me about the restless dead.

aldwin_worry.text: This town is afraid. They come to me for comfort, but I feel the same dread they do. I pray it's enough.

responses.text: Prayer and a sharp sword. That's what we need.

prayer_and_steel.text: Ha. You sound like Rowan. Perhaps you're right. The Light guides, but mortal hands must do the work.

restless_dead.text: Something stirs the dead from their rest. The barrows east of town... graves have been found empty. It grieves me.

undead_cause.text: When the Aether sickens, death's boundary thins. Souls cannot rest in poisoned ground. They wander, lost and angry.

responses.text: Is there a way to put them back to rest?

laying_rest.text: Blessed salt and prayer can grant peace to individual spirits. But until the source is cleansed, more will rise.

responses.text: Can you give me blessed salt?

blessed_supplies.text: Take what you need. Scatter it on the bones and speak the Rite of Passing. I'll teach you the words.

rite_learned.text: Speak with conviction, not volume. The dead hear intent, not words. Grant them the peace they were denied.

responses.text: I understand. I won't let them suffer.

elara_agreement.text: Elara and I rarely agree, but on this we do. The corruption is the root of all our troubles. Goblins, beasts, the dead.

responses.text: Everyone keeps pointing to the same source.

convergence.text: When all paths point one direction, the Light is showing you the way. Be brave enough to walk it.

aldwin_encounter.text: Once. A woman, dead three years, standing at the chapel door. She looked at me and wept. I've not slept well since.

aldwin_grief.text: She was a parishioner. I spoke her funeral rites myself. To see her like that... no one deserves such an end.

responses.text: I'll put an end to this.

ghost_nature.text: No. Not all the risen are violent. Some are confused, grieving. But others... others come back wrong. Hungry.

responses.text: Let me deal with the barrows.

prayer_vs_undead.text: The Light burns what should not walk. A blessing on your blade will make it strike true against the risen.

responses.text: Teach me to pray for myself.

weapon_blessed.text: There. Your steel carries the Light's warmth now. The dead will feel its mercy. Use it well.

barrow_quest.text: The eastern barrows, past the old mill. Be careful. Pray before you enter. And come back alive, please.

barrow_accepted.text: Take blessed salt and keep the prayer close to your heart. The Light goes with you, child. I believe that.

prayer_teaching.text: Prayer is not begging. It is alignment. You still your mind, open your heart, and let the Light fill the cracks.

prayer_basics.text: Close your eyes. Breathe. Speak what troubles you honestly. The Light does not judge. It only listens and mends.

simplicity.text: The deepest truths always are. People complicate faith the way they complicate everything. Keep it simple. Keep it honest.

prayer_learned.text: Good. Use it when you are weary or wounded. It won't replace a healer, but it will keep your spirit whole.

faith_question.text: The Light shines on all equally. Whether you feel its warmth depends on whether you're willing to stand in it.

prayer_power.text: In time, yes. I can mend bone and close wounds through faith alone. But it took decades of devotion to learn.

responses.text: Can you teach me the basics?
I'll stick to potions for now.

about_aldwin.text: A simple cleric who tends the chapel and its flock. I came to Hearthholm seeking quiet. Found purpose instead.

responses.text: This town is lucky to have you.

aldwin_past.text: The Great Seminary in Ashford. Studied twenty years. But faith learned from books pales next to faith tested by life.

responses.text: And life in Hearthholm tested your faith?

faith_tested.text: Every day. When a child cries for a father the goblins took. When the dead walk. And yet, the Light persists. So do I.

aldwin_humble.text: I merely hold the lantern. The people of Hearthholm carry their own light. They just forget sometimes.

end_shop.text: May the Light keep you whole in body and spirit. Return whenever you have need.

end.text: Go in peace, child. The Light walks beside you, even in the darkest places. Remember that.
